concerns.text: FR-001 requires the system to *MUST* download and curate a static subset of exactly 50 failed figures. Task T002 only *attempts* the download and aborts if no verified URL is available, which weakens the mandatory requirement.

FR-011 mandates that aborted tasks be *excluded* from time‑to‑success and iteration‑count calculations. Task T008 treats aborted tasks as right‑censored observations, thereby violating the exclusion rule.
SC-004 specifies a real‑world retention check (≥ 28 valid sessions out of ≥ 32 participants). No task in the list implements this retention verification; the requirement is dropped.
Constitution Principle II requires a Reference‑Validator step for all citations. The task list contains no task that runs the Reference‑Validator Agent, constituting a constitutional violation.

SC-005 demands that the entire pipeline complete within ≤ 6 hours on CPU‑only resources. Task T011 only mocks a 360‑second wall‑clock limit and does not measure actual runtime, leaving the success criterion unverified.
